system.description:
Fight action: Fire Gun: 2. VA by range: Too close to shoot VA 4, optimal VA 3, extreme VA 1 (VA set to the optimal value). Gunpowder die: roll a DoF before rolling to hit; on a 1 the firearm has misfired—reroll: on 4+ it jams or flashes and must be reloaded completely; on 1-3 it misfires: roll the weapon’s DoF and apply the damage to the shooter. Missiles: costs include enough missiles to outfit the character. Special arrowheads/bolt heads cost 1 rp per head type. Poor quality missiles cost half (rounded up) and are +1 Ob to hit; superior quality missiles cost 3x and grant a +1D balance die.

DoF modifiers: exceed obstacle +1, double obstacle +2, triple obstacle +3; extreme range -1 to the DoF.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 557
